# `streaming_content_id_unique`

> A content item appears once in the catalog.

| | |
|---|---|
| Domain | [streaming](README.md) |
| Layer | **silver** — evaluated by the `silver` gate |
| Model | `slv_streaming__content` (`streaming_silver.slv_streaming__content`) |
| Column | `content_id` |
| Check | `unique` |
| Severity | `error` — a violation **stops the pipeline** |
| Defined in | [dbt/models/streaming/silver/_silver.yml](../../../dbt/models/streaming/silver/_silver.yml) |

## What it checks

`content_id` is unique: no two rows share the same value.

## When it fails

The `silver` task of `medallion_streaming` fails, gold and `publish_gold` don't run, and the batch is never added to `streaming_gold`: consumers keep the batches published before. `quality_report` marks the run as blocked and sends the alert, if one is configured.

The rows that broke the rule in its latest evaluation are kept in `dq_audit.streaming_content_id_unique`.

## Tested by

No sample-data scenario trips this rule yet: it guards against cases the generators don't produce.
